description: Open a copy of r-sort-3b-memo (General) read-write. CREATE TABLE MT(ID, TK TEXT(255), T20 TEXT(20)); INSERT INTO MT (ID, TK) SELECT ID, MK FROM MM; INSERT INTO MT (ID, T20) SELECT ID + 100, MK FROM MM WHERE LEN(MK) > 20; UPDATE MM SET TK = MK for the A x256 + x row; SELECT * INTO MM2 FROM MM, ALTER TABLE MM2 ALTER COLUMN MK TEXT(255), then CREATE INDEX IX_MK2 ON MM2 (MK); ALTER TABLE MM ALTER COLUMN TK TEXT(100) with its index IX_TK in place. After each step reads the stored LEN of the assigned columns and, for the indexed ones, the ORDER BY or walk. Asks whether memo-to-Text assignment, UPDATE and column conversion refuse or truncate (the cut length), and what the index over a converted or shortened column then contains.
